preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n and 1 <= vi <= n for ui, vi, x, c in edges)
preconditions.description: Each node index ui and vi must be within the range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**9 + 6 for ui, vi, x, c in edges)
preconditions.description: The clamminess x of each thread must be between 1 and 10^9 + 6.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {0, 1} for ui, vi, x, c in edges)
preconditions.description: Each thread color c must be either 0 (red) or 1 (black).

postconditions.description: The output must be the jelliness of the cobweb modulo 10^9 + 7.
The jelliness must be a positive integer.
